# Intelligent Design Air Conditioning, Plumbing, Solar, Roofing & Electric

> Intelligent Design is a family and veteran-owned home services company in Tucson, Arizona providing HVAC, plumbing, solar, electrical, and roofing services since 1979. BBB A+ rated with 22,000+ five-star reviews. Available 24/7 for emergencies. Phone: (520) 333-2665.

## About the Company

Intelligent Design serves Tucson and Southern Arizona with comprehensive home services. Key facts:
- Family & veteran-owned since 1979
- 45+ years of experience
- 22,000+ five-star reviews across all platforms
- BBB A+ rated
- NATE-certified HVAC technicians
- Licensed master plumbers and electricians
- 24/7 emergency service available
- Upfront pricing with no hidden fees
- 100% satisfaction guarantee
